nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking API/convention/file-structure changes vs training data; instructs reading node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heeding deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Migrating Postgres data to USB SSD via GYM_DATA_PATH
nodes.rationale: Postgres data lives in a bind mount controlled by GYM_DATA_PATH so it can be moved to an SSD by rsyncing the data directory and repointing the env var, with zero data loss and no reinstall.
nodes.norm_label: migrating postgres data to usb ssd via gym_data_path

nodes.label: Pre-internet-exposure security checklist
nodes.rationale: Checklist ensures secrets are rotated from defaults, restart:always is set, Postgres stays bound to localhost only, backups run and are copied off-Pi, and a UPS protects the Pi/router before exposing the API publicly.

nodes.label: Replaces 7-container Supabase self-hosted stack with 2 containers
nodes.rationale: FastAPI acts as gateway, auth, and data layer simultaneously, so Kong/GoTrue/PostgREST/Storage/postgres-meta/Studio are no longer needed, collapsing the stack from 7 containers to 2 (db + api).
nodes.norm_label: replaces 7-container supabase self-hosted stack with 2 containers
